steps.en: Officer confirms the revival in the prompt
steps.id: Officer mengonfirmasi revival lewat pertanyaan konfirmasi

steps.en: On confirm the UI sends the revive request at once
steps.id: Setelah konfirmasi, UI langsung mengirim request revive

steps.en: The system checks reason, remarks and notice before reviving
steps.id: Sistem memeriksa alasan, remarks dan notice sebelum revive

steps.en: Active suspensions are marked revived right away
steps.id: Suspension aktif langsung ditandai sudah direvive

steps.en: The notice record is refreshed to show it is no longer suspended
steps.id: Data notice diperbarui sehingga tidak lagi berstatus suspended

steps.en: A reduction is undone and the original amount returns
steps.id: Reduction dibatalkan dan jumlah awal dikembalikan
steps.why_en: The amount restore is best-effort: failures are only logged and the revive still shows success.
steps.why_id: Pengembalian jumlah bersifat sebisanya: kegagalan hanya dicatat di log dan revive tetap tampil berhasil.
